name: Oficina Mecânica · Saga
description: A saga da OS pelos três serviços (docs/fase-4/CONTRATOS.md §8, no oficina-api): marcos SagaStarted, SagaStepCompleted, SagaCompensated e SagaFailed, PaymentConfirmed do Faturamento, o log message.processed dos workers e o trace pela fila. Importado por scripts/newrelic-import.py, que troca a conta e o ambiente.

pages.name: Saga
pages.description: Funil, tempo por passo e compensações.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Sagas abertas' FROM SagaStarted WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 1 day ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'REPAIR') AS 'Concluídas', filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaCompensated') AS 'Compensadas', filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaFailed') - filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaCompensated' AND afterFailure IS true) AS 'Falharam (pedem uma pessoa)' FROM SagaStepCompleted, SagaCompensated, SagaFailed WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Pagamentos', sum(amount) AS 'Valor (R$)' FROM PaymentConfirmed WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 1 day ago

SELECT funnel(sagaId, WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStarted' AS 'Aberta', WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'DIAGNOSIS' AS 'Diagnóstico', WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'BUDGET' AS 'Orçamento', WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'APPROVAL' AS 'Aprovação', WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'PAYMENT' AS 'Pagamento', WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStepCompleted' AND step = 'REPAIR' AS 'Reparo') FROM SagaStarted, SagaStepCompleted WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT average(durationSeconds) AS 'média', percentile(durationSeconds, 95) AS 'p95' FROM SagaStepCompleted WHERE env = 'prod' FACET step SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Compensações' FROM SagaCompensated WHERE env = 'prod' FACET failedStep, reason SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaCompensated') * 100 / filter(count(*), WHERE eventType() = 'SagaStarted') AS '% compensadas' FROM SagaStarted, SagaCompensated WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES 1 hour
SELECT timestamp, sagaId, orderId, failedStep, reason, pending, correlationId FROM SagaFailed WHERE env = 'prod' SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Mensageria
pages.description: Workers, trace pela fila, DLQs e sagas paradas.

widgets.title: Mensagens processadas por serviço e resultado

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE env = 'prod' AND message = 'message.processed' FACET service, outcome SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT count(*) AS 'Erros', latest(exception_message) AS 'Último erro' FROM Log WHERE env = 'prod' AND message = 'message.processed' AND outcome = 'error' FACET service, message_type SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20
SELECT average(duration_ms) AS 'média', percentile(duration_ms, 95) AS 'p95' FROM Log WHERE env = 'prod' AND message = 'message.processed' FACET message_type SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 30

SELECT count(*) AS 'Mensagens', average(duration * 1000) AS 'ms (média)', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS '% erro' FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('oficina-api-prod', 'oficina-faturamento-prod', 'oficina-execucao-prod') AND name LIKE '%message/%' FACET appName, name SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 30
SELECT max(provider.approximateNumberOfMessagesVisible.Maximum) AS 'na DLQ' FROM QueueSample WHERE provider.queueName LIKE 'oficina-prod-%-dlq' FACET provider.queueName SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Sagas paradas além do prazo (alerta ao mecânico)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, saga_id, os_id, step, correlation_id FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND env = 'prod' AND message = 'saga.stalled' SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50
